title: Sample-size presets (confirmatory unit counts)
description: The single source of the confirmatory unit counts (#266): schedules/presets/sample-size-presets.json. Each preset names the Study A batch count, the Study B pair count and the Study B spare slots; every schedules generator takes a preset name (default: 'default'). Pilot sizes (3 batches; 8 pairs, no spares) and the per-unit structure (3 profiles, 3 hand designers, 3 methods, 4 learners per book, 3 raters per panel, Study B blocks of 4) are fixed in every preset. Preset names are unique (checked by av_schedules.presets). See schedules/docs/curriculum.md.

default.description: Preset used when none is given; one of the preset names.

a_batches.description: Study A confirmatory batches: 3 profiles x 2 swap levels per 6; IDs A-C01..A-C96.

b_pairs.description: Study B confirmatory pairs (dyad slots) in complete blocks of 4 (SQ arm x swap); IDs B-C01..B-C96.

b_spares.description: Study B spare slots, complete blocks of 4 after the main blocks (one spare bank each); IDs B-S01..B-S96.
